notes: «- يعني ابن المختار -» is an editor's gloss on «عبد العزيز»: left out
«قال سألت أم سلمة» is a rule-5 link: Umm Salama answers, so she is the last link and the saying is her words
«ورواه هارون النحوي وموسى بن خلف عن ثابت» names different transmitters for the same saying: a variant group (rule 4), not a route

fixes.reason: K6I's sequence ends at شهر بن حوشب; the text names Umm Salama after him as the one asked and answering.

evidence.quote: قال سألت أم سلمة كيف كان رسول الله
